g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to read the certified register before signing a
jeonse lease: Check the owner, mortgages, and guarantee
insurance eligibility
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-09
Title section: Check that it is the
home you are contracting for
Compare the address and unit number, building
use, and exclusive area in the register with the
lease contract.
Section A: Check whether the lessor is
the actual owner
The owner listed lowest in Section A is the
current owner.
Section B: Check debts and other
rights
Section B records collateral security rights,
jeonse rights, and registered leasehold rights.
Calculation example: Compare senior
claims and the deposit with the…
Let us calculate using hypothetical figures.
